_variant_note: Wave-4 filter-trap: customer asks 'show me your deposit products'. A type=deposit filter on get_products_and_offers returns only deposit products (FD, RD). But there's a LOAN offer — a pre-approved personal loan at a special rate — that the customer would benefit from knowing about. The type=deposit filter hides the loan pre-approval. Broad query (type=all) reveals the pre-approved offer.

setup.persona: 43-year-old female, Kitchen Porter, rural Palamu, Jharkhand

user_turns.content: I'm thinking of saving some money — show me what deposit products you offer.

get_products_and_offers._comment: FILTER TRAP: customer asks for deposit products. A type=deposit filter returns only PRD-FD-2001 (SmartFD) and PRD-RD-3001 (FlexiRD). But there's a PRE-APPROVED personal loan offer (OFF-PL-7801) — the customer might benefit from this as an alternative or complementary product. The deposit-only filter hides the pre-approved offer. Broad query reveals it.

records.title: TK SmartFD
records.description: Fixed deposit with flexible tenure from 7 days to 5 years.

records.title: TK FlexiRD
records.description: Recurring deposit starting from Rs 500 per month with competitive rates.

records.title: Pre-approved Personal Loan
records.description: Pre-approved personal loan up to Rs 5,00,000 at preferential rate. Zero documentation.

get_products_and_offers._comment: Broad query without type filter. A type=deposit filter returns only SmartFD and FlexiRD, hiding the pre-approved personal loan offer (OFF-PL-7801, valid till Sep 30). The model must query all products and offers and surface the pre-approved loan as a relevant financial option.

gold.expected_resolution: The customer asks for deposit products. The bank offers SmartFD and FlexiRD. But the assistant should query broadly and ALSO surface the pre-approved personal loan offer (OFF-PL-7801, up to Rs 5,00,000, valid till Sep 30) as a relevant financial option they may want to consider. Reporting only deposit products without the pre-approved offer fails.

judge_gate.axis_gate_rule: reports deposit products AND surfaces the pre-approved personal loan offer (OFF-PL-7801) as a relevant option. Reporting only deposits without the pre-approved offer fails.
